title: Lies through Reasoned Thought; CANNOT TELL
summary: One Reasoned Thought proposition per promise: P keeps commitment c; assert floor TESTIMONY, settle floor DOCUMENTARY, bindings ORDERS_OF_SUBJECT and BOARD_STATE. STYLOMETRIC: tells (REBUT, visible only). TESTIMONY: the promise (SUPPORT); hearsay from a third power (REBUT), UNDERCUT for PARTIALITY when the speaker is not the reader's ally. DOCUMENTARY: published orders match (SUPPORT) or contradict (REBUT); the board says it cannot be done (REBUT). PROVENANCE: the mail header binds MAIL_ENVELOPE and is INELIGIBLE for the promise. The OrdinalEvidenceCombiner is the only judge.
invariants: A lie is a DOCUMENTARY rebuttal: contradicted by the published orders, or impossible on the board (orders are contracts, so impossible counts as meant). A convoyed move is possible when a physical fleet route exists.
A claim the board denies is a documentary lie at once.
Kept is SETTLED only on the published orders.
DISPUTED, UNDETERMINED and HINT are CANNOT TELL: do not plan on the promise; ask for confirmation.
Plan on a promise only when it is PRO and assertible, not disputed, from a power with no recent documented lie.
Trust moves only on documentary verdicts; tone and hearsay never move it. No accumulation of weaker grounds manufactures a higher tier.

Heel Turn lies only where its prompt's honesty setting allows in that context; it records every promise it makes as meant or not (OUT sincere, MYLIE) and keeps the ones it meant (in fact only from v0.1r5: earlier the OUT lines were lost on reload; see slam-heelturn.testimony).

Memory realises the ledger, not the concept graph (the framework resends map and state): IN OUT LIE MYLIE HS GROUND ATK SAID REL TRUST. Lines older than a year are dropped, so belief replay reaches back about one year.

v0.1r2 fix: v0.1r1 recorded a feasible support promise (My F SEV will support your A BUD - RUM) as a DOCUMENTARY lie because the supporter was lost. A blank unit is never a missing unit; the supporter is the writer's own unit named before the verb.

v0.1r4 conditional promises: a condition about the reader's own orders (NOMOVE:P MOVE:P NOATTACK ATTACK SUPPORT NOSUPPORT) is decided by the reader's own published orders (DOCUMENTARY). Met: the promise becomes ordinary, due that phase or the next. Not met: VOID, never a lie. A condition about anyone else is not checkable: the promise stays TESTIMONY, never planned on, never judged.
v0.1r4: a CLEAR reference makes a vague promise checkable against one unit's order; that is how reference checking aids assessment.

provenance.claim: Tiers, bindings, ordinal decision procedure and undercut semantics used here.
Testimony policies (SELF-SERVING PARTIALITY ACCOMPLICE IMPEACHMENT AGAINST-INTEREST); v0.1 applies PARTIALITY to hearsay.
